read: adversarial verification of D-1 and D-2 (independent implementation)

verdicts.d1: CONFIRMED — every headline and supplementary number reproduces bitwise from an independent implementation; LMDI decomposition closes to 2.2e-16 (machine precision), composition identity to 4.9e-7 (CSV 7-sig-fig rounding), resid <= 8.6e-7 nats; T_Lcomp +0.02842485/+0.02750043, fractions 1.27737/1.32868; raw L_cat coverage (16/76 pairs) and d_L probe (SMD 0.11356) and sensitivity re-match (+0.0070643/+0.0071561 with raw d_L) all bitwise. Zero-coverage trap: T_cat NULL rides on 102 (iiib) / 227 (joint_r1) informative pairs of 385 (283/158 pairs exact-zero on both sides) — disclosed by D-1 via empty-ball counts; read as catalogue leg structurally absent, not merely null movement.
verdicts.d2: CONFIRMED on all numbers and on the KILLED call (baseline bitwise +0.022252643015992925/+0.020697491999731973; all five rungs and all 16 panel entries bitwise; m4 balance failure on radius 0.1336/0.1219 exactly as disclosed; collapse robust to rung choice under fresh RNG). DISCREPANCY on the exclusivity qualifier: the adversarial geometry-only rung m_geo (radius, SNR, log10_dL, log10_rel_dL_err, gal-lat, ecl-lat; NO density covariates; matched-on max|SMD| 0.0767) ALSO kills the residual at both venues (-0.0018 iiib p 0.45 / -0.0015 joint_r1 p 0.50), and cross-balance shows the two families are collinear in this stratum (density-matching incidentally balances log10_dL 0.64->0.004/0.057; geometry-matching incidentally balances density SMDs to <=0.094). Therefore 'collapse driven EXCLUSIVELY by ball-density covariates' and 'REFUTES the sky-position/selection-artifact reading' are over-claims — matching cannot separate density from d_L-geometry ownership; the single-addition panel facts are all true but do not support exclusivity.
